clientInfo.name: Magnit profiled
clientInfo.terms:
Sub-contractors - No subcontractors are approved. The assigned supplier is required to pay wages and taxes, etc.

Credit Score - The supplier must meet a credit score requirement of at least 40 from Credit Safe which is the credit institution used.

Assignment length - Upon assignment, the supplier undertakes the entire contract period, including any use of extension, if the customer chooses to activate.

VAT - Supplier is required to have a Swedish VAT registration.
